spec.title: Clasificación Acceso SSH Acertados por Direccion IP

spec.query: source=wazuh-states-vulnerabilities-* | where agent.id != '000' | stats count() as total_cves by agent.name | sort -total_cves | head 10
source=wazuh-states-vulnerabilities-* | where agent.id != '000' | stats count() as total by vulnerability.severity | head 100
rule.id: "5760" AND full_log: "Failed password" AND NOT agent.id: *000*
